title: Quaint German Flatbread
description: A garlicky, crumbly, and kid-friendly German dish featuring passion fruit pulp, made with long-fermentation dough, suitable for Buddhist temple gatherings.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine bread flour, water, salt, and yeast, mixing until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes, until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it ferment in a warm place for 12 hours.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Punch down the dough and roll it out into a thin sheet, about 1/4 inch thick.
Brush the dough with olive oil, sprinkle with minced garlic, and spread passion fruit pulp evenly over the surface.
Bake the flatbread in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until it is golden brown and crispy.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and let it cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes.
Cut the flatbread into wedges and serve warm.
